description: Fork of exp099 widening E to 384 and d_v=64 (H=6, H*d_v=384=E). d_qk=32 (full V2D, D_QK_P=496) instead of 42 — exp102 showed d_qk=32 with full V2D matches d_qk=42 with full V2D, while sparse V2D hurt. LUT weight count is unchanged because SparseScatter makes per-table weights depend on n_sparse_outputs instead of n_outputs; only embedding and unembedder grow with E. SparseLut config unchanged: qk_joint and v_lut at nap=8 tph=384 n_sparse=8; out_proj at nap=8 tph=2048 n_sparse=8.
